newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Michael Laws finishes working for NZ First - RNZ.
newsitem.headline: Michael Laws finishes working for NZ First - RNZ.

text.p: New Zealand First campaign strategist Michael Laws has finished working for the party and is going to write a book, Radio NZ said on Wednesday.

It said Laws had been contracted to work for New Zealand First until this month and quoted him as saying he had a contract with a publisher to write a book about politics. The book would be published early next year.
NZ First officials were not immediately available to comment.
